basic_details.short_information: Kerala Agricultural University will hold a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at RARS(SZ), College of Agriculture, Vellayani, Thiruvananthapuram — 695 522, with certificate verification from 10 a.m. and the interview from 11 a.m. onwards. The Regional Agricultural Research Station (Southern Zone), Vellayani is filling 1 post of Technical Officer on temporary basis under the Mission Mausam (ACROSS merged) scheme IMD-GKMS Project at AMFU, Vellayani, for a monthly consolidated pay. Candidates not above 40 years as on 18 November 2026 with the prescribed agricultural qualifications may attend.

age_limit.details: The age of the applicant should not be above 40 years as on 18 November 2026.

qualification.details: There is one vacancy for Technical Officer (temporary basis). NET conducted by ICAR. Candidates who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil/Ph.D. degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time, as the case may be, may be exempted from NET. | All other conditions are as per the Kerala Agricultural University statute and relevant UGC regulations. | The age of the applicant should not be above 40 years as on 18 November 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: The appointment will be purely provisional for a period of 1 year or till the appointment of regular hands, whichever comes earlier. The appointment will be on contract basis and purely temporary; the candidate will have no claim in the university other than to receive the monthly consolidated pay attached to the post. If selected for appointment, the candidate will execute an agreement in the prescribed form on stamp paper worth Rs 200/-. The selected candidate will discharge all duties attached to the post as per regulations and rules, and those assigned from time to time by the head of Institution/Department. The University has the right to terminate the temporary appointment if the performance is found unsatisfactory or any such defects are noticed. The undersigned reserves all rights to take all appropriate decisions about the selection process, including its cancellation at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The Regional Agricultural Research Station (Southern Zone), Vellayani is a station of Kerala Agricultural University in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The Technical Officer will work under the Mission Mausam (ACROSS merged) scheme IMD-GKMS Project at AMFU, Vellayani. The notice is issued by Dr. Geetha Radhakrishnan, Associate Professor & PI, RARS(SZ), Vellayani. The station's email address printed on the notice is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one vacancy for Technical Officer (temporary basis). The notice lists the following educational qualifications for the post: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture recognized by Kerala Agricultural University. Master's Degree in M.Sc. (Ag) in Agricultural Meteorology recognized by Kerala Agricultural University with a minimum of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed). NET conducted by ICAR. Candidates who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil/Ph.D. degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time, as the case may be, may be exempted from NET. All other conditions are as per the Kerala Agricultural University statute and relevant UGC regulations. The age of the applicant should not be above 40 years as on 18 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.relaxation: As prescribed in the KS & SSR 1958 as amended from time to time

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates to prove qualification. Original certificates to prove age. Original certificates to prove experience. A self-attested copy of each of these certificates. All other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026. Certificate verification starts at 10 a.m., and the interview will be conducted from 11 a.m. onwards. Candidates should reach the venue at RARS(SZ), Vellayani, Thiruvananthapuram 695 522, Keralam in time. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be purely provisional for a period of 1 year or till the appointment of regular hands, whichever comes earlier. The appointment will be on contract basis and purely temporary; the candidate will have no claim in the university other than to receive the monthly consolidated pay attached to the post. If selected for appointment, the candidate will execute an agreement in the prescribed form on stamp paper worth Rs 200/-. The selected candidate will discharge all duties attached to the post as per regulations and rules, and those assigned from time to time by the head of Institution/Department. The University has the right to terminate the temporary appointment if the performance is found unsatisfactory or any such defects are noticed. The undersigned reserves all rights to take all appropriate decisions about the selection process, including its cancellation at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the KAU Technical Officer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026 at RARS(SZ), College of Agriculture, Vellayani, Thiruvananthapuram — 695 522, with certificate verification from 10 a.m. and the interview from 11 a.m. onwards.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there for Technical Officer?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Technical Officer (temporary basis) under the Mission Mausam (ACROSS merged) scheme IMD-GKMS Project at AMFU, Vellayani.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the KAU Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The notice lists a Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture recognized by KAU, a Master's Degree in M.Sc. (Ag) in Agricultural Meteorology recognized by KAU with a minimum of 55% marks, and NET conducted by ICAR, with Ph.D. holders under the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 possibly exempted from NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KAU Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be above 40 years as on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: The age limit is relaxable for SC/ST/OBC and differently abled categories as prescribed in the KS & SSR 1958 as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring original certificates to prove qualification, age and experience, a self-attested copy of each, and all other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Technical Officer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026, preceded by certificate verification starting at 10 a.m.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KAU Technical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract basis and purely temporary, provisional for 1 year or till the appointment of regular hands, whichever comes earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
